item_short_desc: This durable laminated steel padlock is designed for maximum security, featuring a wide, reinforced body for superior strength. The hardened steel shackle offers extra cut resistance, while the 4-pin tumbler cylinder helps prevent picking. Dual locking levers provide added protection against prying, and each lock is keyed differently for unique, non-rekeyable security. Ideal for protecting your valuables with reliable, high-performance design. Great for lockers, gym, or securing personal belongings.
